title: Florida at Work
details: 📅 Q3 · Unit 10 · Modern Florida Takes Shape

badge.name: Field Seal 22
badge.line: Only field historians earn this one. You went where your teacher can't go, and you brought back proof.

hook.look: A field file is a job card. It tells a historian where to go and what to bring back.
hook.head: Field File 22 · Florida at Work
rows: Florida's big industries, all in one place
Your teacher, still stuck inside Canvas
hook.alt: A tall white rocket lifting off in a cloud of fire and smoke
hook.cap: Apollo 11 lifts off from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, July 16, 1969. NASA.
hook.note: Florida's jobs come from its land, water and weather. Can you build all of Florida's big industries in one place, so I can see them?

opti.brief: She can't leave Canvas, so you build it. Put Florida's big industries around one hub. Then send her one photo.
opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Play the game, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.look: An industry is a big kind of business where many people do the same kind of work. This map has grassy alcoves, small open rooms around the middle. Put one industry in each alcove.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Explorations in Filter environments. Click OptimaED Explorations Hub, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the industries
steps.html: Put the globe in the middle. Put one model in each alcove: the Ferris wheel for tourism, the orange for farming, the net for fishing, the crate for trade, the rocket for space.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit your whole build in the tablet. Click Take photo.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new photo.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Make the Ferris wheel the biggest. Tourism is Florida's number one industry.

vr.full: One photo that shows all five industries and the globe in the middle.

studio.title: Why Here?
studio.look: Each picture on the left is a Florida industry. Each line on the right tells why it grows in Florida.
studio.do: Tap a picture. Then tap the line that goes with it.

game.miss: Not that line. Think about Florida's land, water and weather.
game.done: All six match! Florida's industries grow from its geography.

pairs.right: Rockets fly east over the ocean, away from people
pairs.ok: Yes! That's why rockets launch from Florida's east coast.

left.name: The first train to Key West, 1912

pairs.right: A warm climate and a long growing season

pairs.ok: Yes! Florida's coast feeds the fishing industry.

pairs.right: Warm weather and beaches bring visitors

pairs.ok: Yes! Ports connect Florida to the world.

studio.full: Your game is done, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
